EPISODE NUMBER: Episode 1
EPISODE LOGLINE: A humiliated maid at her stepsister's gala learns she is the true heiress.
CONTINUITY NOTES: First episode. Establishes Maya, Victoria, Lord Henry, Grandmother Eleanor and Mr. Cross.

--- SCRIPT START ---

SCENE 01
Scene heading: INT. ASHFORD MANOR BALLROOM – NIGHT
Scene start: 00:00.00
Scene end: 01:08.00

Actions and dialogue:

Wide shot of a glittering ballroom; guests in evening wear turn toward the grand staircase.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:00.50) | End: (00:04.50)
Maya, in a plain grey maid's uniform, carries a silver tray of champagne through the crowd.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:04.80) | End: (00:08.00)
Medium shot of Victoria in a crimson gown, smirking as Maya approaches.

**VICTORIA (Mocking, Loud):**
Start: (00:05.20) | End: (00:07.60)
"Careful, servant. That tray costs more than you."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:08.00) | End: (00:11.00)
Close-up on Maya's lowered eyes.

**MAYA (Quiet):**
Start: (00:08.60) | End: (00:10.40)
"Yes, Miss Victoria."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:11.00) | End: (00:14.50)
Medium two-shot as Victoria lifts her glass and pours red wine over Maya's head.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:11.30) | End: (00:14.30)
Victoria slowly empties her wine glass over Maya's head while the guests gasp.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:14.50) | End: (00:17.30)

Start: (00:14.50) | End: (00:17.30)

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:17.30) | End: (00:21.50)

Start: (00:17.60) | End: (00:21.20)
"Know your place. Maids don't get to look at Lord Henry."

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:21.50) | End: (00:25.10)

**LORD HENRY (Amused, Dismissive):**
Start: (00:22.00) | End: (00:24.80)

Start: (00:25.10) | End: (00:29.50)
Close-up on Maya's hands trembling around the tray.

**ACTION:**
Start: (00:25.10) | End: (00:29.50)
Maya grips the tray until her knuckles whiten, refusing to cry.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:29.50) | End: (00:33.50)
Wide shot of guests whispering and pointing.

**CAMERA:**
Start: (00:33.50) | End: (00:37.30)

**MR. CROSS (Firm):**
Start: (00:56.60) | End: (00:59.20)
